results.title: Neon Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs & Limits
results.content:
Neon pricing starts with a free plan; paid Launch and Scale plans charge for actual usage with no monthly minimum. Database compute costs $0.106 per CU-hour on Launch and $0.222 on Scale, with storage billed separately. The main budget question is how much compute runs, and for how long—not how many colleagues log in.

Pricing checked September 25, 2026. US dollars; taxes excluded from illustrative calculations. Annual rates are monthly equivalents, not monthly invoices. [...] | Plan | Billing | Database allowance or rate | When it fits |

| Launch | Usage billed monthly; no fixed annual equivalent | $0.106/CU-hour; $0.35/GB-month | Applications that exceed Free without requiring Scale controls | [...] Jet Admin Pro is $20/month on monthly billing, or $192/year ($16/month equivalent); Business is $100/month or $960/year ($80/month equivalent). Business includes granular permissions, SSO, and audit logs. Check Jet Admin’s current plan gates.

results.title: Neon’s New Pricing, Explained: Usage-Based, No Minimum - Neon
results.content:
We now offer three plans: Free, Launch, and Scale, with usage-based pricing across the board. This is a summary of how they break down – check out our pricing page for details.

### Free: Perfect for learning, hacking, and shipping early ideas

Everything you need to start building on Neon, completely free – including: [...] Launch is an ideal paid plan for growing projects and early startups that care more about keeping costs low than meeting compliance requirements or production-grade reliability standards.

It’s fully usage-based with no monthly minimum:

 Pay-as-you-go compute at $0.14 per CU-hour.
 Pay-as-you-go storage at $0.35 per GB-month
 10 branches/project included, then $0.002 per branch-hour

You also get extras like: [...] Scale is our highest-tier plan, designed for production-grade workloads that require advanced security, availability, and compliance features. Like Launch, Scale is fully usage-based, with all of its additional capabilities included within its $0.26 per CU-hour compute price.

These features reflect the higher operational demands of running mission-critical systems on Neon, and include:

Branches share storage with their parent, which is the mechanism keeping the Neon number low.
